title: About The Luxury Look
intro: Award-winning interior design and home staging, founded by Kristine Vowles.
body:
The Luxury Look is an interior design and home staging firm with a focus on spaces that feel personal, beautiful and intentional.

Founder and CEO Kristine Vowles established the firm in 2013, building on extensive experience in real estate and design. The company works across residential interiors, staging, Airbnb spaces and corporate environments.

Our approach pairs attentive collaboration with the details that make a room unforgettable.

title: The Studio
intro: A creative meeting place for the next chapter of your space.
body:
The Luxury Look Design Studio is located in Old Town Scottsdale at 4343 N Scottsdale Rd. Suite 150.

By appointment only. Our team can review materials, samples, furnishings and design concepts with clients.

Contact us to schedule a studio consultation.

title: Awards & Recognition
intro: Industry recognition for design, home staging and leadership.
body:
The Luxury Look has been recognized by the International Luxury Lifestyle Awards, and founder Kristine Vowles has received recognition in the home staging and real estate communities.

Awards listed on our previous website include Best Luxury Design Firm in Scottsdale, Best of Houzz in Customer Service and recognition from RESA. Explore our design philosophy and selected projects for a closer look at the work behind the recognition.

title: Luxury Residential Interior Design
intro: Every home has its own character. Kristine leads a thoughtful, personal design process from the first conversation through the finishing details.
body: A design house for high-end and second homes, with thoughtful guidance in layout, materials, furnishings and details.

title: Luxury Specs & Market-Ready
intro: A strategic design partner for luxury properties that need to be remembered, from custom and spec homes to occupied and vacant listings.
body: We combine an understanding of real estate presentation with thoughtful interiors, careful project coordination and purposeful finishing details.

title: Luxury Home Staging
intro: The right presentation invites buyers to picture the life that could unfold in a home. Our staging approach is tailored to the property, its audience and its timeline.
body: Vacant and occupied staging, select-room refreshes, and styling for real-estate photography. Scope and pricing are discussed after a property review.

title: The Luxury Look Collection
intro: Furnishings, art and housewares selected to feel cohesive and personal, whether you're finishing a primary residence or making a second home ready to enjoy.
body: Turnkey furnishing and sourcing support by inquiry. Product availability, trade terms and purchasing arrangements depend on the selected scope.

title: Buying Trips & Curated Sourcing
intro: Design-led sourcing journeys for clients who value clarity, access and considered selections. Dallas Market is one possible destination, not the entire offering.
body: Choose a guided market experience or a custom sourcing conversation tailored to your project. Dates, travel arrangements, eligibility, access and fees are discussed individually.
